tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The ground. Solid form of the site's scrim colour rgb(20,20,23); use it wherever there is no photograph behind the content.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Full-bleed overlay laid over the background photograph so white type reads (body::before on the site). Never show a photo behind text without it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Frosted section panel (Carrd container style1): this fill + the grain texture + backdrop blur `blur-panel` over the photograph.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Ink of the fractal-noise grain texture (assets/Textures/grain.svg), tiled at 512px over the scrim and on panels. Derived exactly from the texture's colour matrix; do not use as a flat fill.

tokens.name: curtain
tokens.usage: Page-load curtain that fades out over 0.875s (body::after). Not a content surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, button labels and borders, icon fills. 18.4:1 on `night`; on a photograph it must sit on `scrim` or `panel`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Highlighted words (<mark>) inside body text and the hover colour of links. 4.24:1 on `night`: below 4.5:1, so keep it to marked words in 1rem+ text or 24px+ text, never small body copy. Exact from source.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text (white at 0.55 opacity), on `night` or `panel`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one hue. Inline links in body text, highlighted words in eyebrows, link hover in eyebrows, and the focus ring. 5.2:1 on `night`. Never a fill behind white text (3.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders: 3px on buttons, 1px on inputs. Always white, always square.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 3px, around buttons and fields (an addition; the source defines none). 5.2:1 on `night`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Off-white of the page under the photograph and the letterforms of the NCRT wordmark. For light grounds outside the site (print, merch); `night` text on it is 17.3:1.

tokens.name: wordmark-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the NCRT wordmark lockup (sampled from the share image, a JPEG, so treat as approximate). Use behind the wordmark when it is set as a solid tile.

tokens.name: code-wash
tokens.usage: Background of inline code and of <mark> outside the text styles.

tokens.name: spoiler
tokens.usage: Spoiler-text cover; revealed text turns `ink`.

tokens.name: video-ground
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind embedded video frames.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The team name in the hero, once per page. UPPERCASE. Below 737px: 2.25rem with 0.4375rem tracking. (Carrd text style2.)

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles (GET IN TOUCH, FEES AND PROCESS, the founder's name, 3-4 DAY TRAININGS). UPPERCASE. Below 737px: 1.5rem, 0.4375rem tracking. (style3)

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Course-tier titles under an eyebrow. UPPERCASE, left aligned. Below 737px: 1.5rem. (style10)

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Small sentence-case headings inside a panel (Watch the Video, The Need for Readiness) and role lines (Founder and Head of Operations). Centred in panels (style9), left beside portraits (style5).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above a heading. UPPERCASE; marked words in `signal`. Below 737px: 0.35rem tracking. (style4)

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Together, we're building a network of capable individuals, ready to help anyone in need.
styles.usage: Hero intro and founder bio. Links `signal`, no underline. (style1)

styles.name: body-tight
styles.sample: Have you ever wondered what you would do if you got injured in the backcountry?
styles.usage: Long-form paragraphs in panels and the form intro. (style8)

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Course names and the hero kicker line (Rescue trainings across the Midwest and Southeast). Title Case. (style6)

styles.name: item-body
styles.sample: Expect to grasp the fundamentals of medical assessment and treatment, and patient movement with makeshift litters.
styles.usage: Course descriptions and parenthetical notes under a tier title. Grows to 1rem below 737px. (style7)

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Button and submit labels. UPPERCASE. Below 737px: 1rem.

styles.name: field
styles.sample: Which course(s) are you interested in?
styles.usage: Text typed into inputs and textareas, and checkbox labels.

spacing.note: Root size is 16pt (21.33px) above 1680px wide, 12pt (16px) from 1680px down, 10pt (13.33px) from 980px down. Every value is rem, so the whole layout scales with it.

tokens.name: space-label
tokens.usage: Space above a form label (0.75rem below it).

tokens.name: space-buttons
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-field
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Default vertical gap between elements in a section.

tokens.name: space-media
tokens.usage: Space above and below an embedded video and a button row.

tokens.name: gutter-panel
tokens.usage: Column gutter in transparent two-column sections (founder, contact).

tokens.name: gutter-section
tokens.usage: Column gutter in frosted course sections; also the page's inner padding on every side.

tokens.name: button-pad-start
tokens.usage: Button left padding (balances the 0.4rem tracking on the label).

tokens.name: button-pad-end
tokens.usage: Button right padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, inputs, checkboxes, panels, images, video. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Inline code only.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and single-line inputs.

tokens.name: textarea-height
tokens.usage: Height of the message textarea.

tokens.name: checkbox-size
tokens.usage: Checkbox square.

tokens.name: form-width
tokens.usage: Width of the interest form.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Max content width inside the page padding.

tokens.name: grain-tile
tokens.usage: Tile size of the grain texture.

tokens.name: border-button
tokens.usage: Button and submit outline, solid `line`.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Input, textarea, select and checkbox outline, solid `line`.

tokens.name: blur-panel
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur on frosted panels.

tokens.name: bp-xlarge
tokens.usage: At or below: root 12pt.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: At or below: root 10pt.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: At or below: mobile type sizes, columns stack.

tokens.name: bp-xsmall
tokens.usage: Smallest tuned width; body min-width is 320px.
